description: Every route the hub serves under /api/station/. tests/test_contracts_routes.py reads the hub's dispatchers and fails when one of their routes has no row here, or a row here is not served (fail closed). `credential`: the kinds of bearer token the code takes on the route today: sz1 (a station's own token), shared (the hub's one shared station token), status (the read-only status token), sw1 (a worker's token). `role`: who may reach the route once roles exist (docs/nodes.md 3), per kind of token: `always`, `never`, or the roles of which the node needs one. `request` / `response`: the schema in contracts/schemas/ for the JSON body sent and for the 200 answer, null where there is no JSON body or no schema yet.

routes.note: The only route a status token opens. Its consumer is the deploy check, not a station.
By event type: `source_*` events need feed-adapter (and the current lease for health), every other event radio-receive.
The long poll: only the jobs for that node and its roles.
A job's answer. docs/nodes.md 3 names only the long poll; this row follows it.
Each clip's speech-to-text input, from the station that captured it. Not in the table of docs/nodes.md 3: the role here is proposed.
A station's token is taken here only while its whisper is in the pool; otherwise 403, never 404.
The answer is audio/wav, not JSON. Only for the holder of that lease.
Prompts: a worker's token only. A station's token gets 403.

reserved.note: Designed for later (docs/nodes.md 3): nothing is served under it today. A route added there needs its rows above first.

designed.note: Designed, NOT served yet (the hub's work: docs/native/capture-split.md 11, H1). Capture's own sender hands the hub emergency alarms and live pages ahead of the app's lane. Decided: an sz1 credential with the radio-receive role (a station's own token stands for the role until roles exist), never sw1. A post here does not count as the station being seen; a hub that is not the leader answers 503 and applies nothing. `designed` rows are not in `routes`, so the tests that hold `routes` to the hub's dispatchers do not see them; tests/test_contracts_capture.py holds this row's shape and fails the day the hub serves the path: move the row to `routes` then (its first six keys are a route row's).
